items.visa_refused: Before start: total fees received refunded minus Application and Admission Fees and the lesser of 5% of total fees received or AUD 500, within 28 working days of a complete signed form with the government refusal letter. After start (visa extension not granted): calculated under the ESOS refund specification.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 4 calendar weeks before CoE start date: 80% of tuition paid for the term/study period plus other unused tuition, less application fee (AUD 200 onshore / AUD 300 offshore) and AUD 550 Refund Administration Fee. Less than 4 weeks: 0%. Withdrawal after Letter of Offer and deposit but before CoE: AUD 550 administrative fee.
items.withdraw_after_start: No separate percentage; general calculation: unused tuition minus used tuition, minus two weeks' tuition for processing, minus AUD 550. Leave of absence/deferral/suspension: 0% for the affected period.
items.non_refundable: Application and Admission Fees; ELICOS material fee once commenced; only tuition fees refundable; unsuccessful RPL 0%; OSHC/homestay/airport pick-up refunded under the service provider's policy.
items.provider_default: Full refund of unused fees within 2 weeks (stated as 10 working days) or an alternative course at no extra cost (student chooses); TPS assists if neither is possible.
items.document: PP-07 International Student Refund Policy & Procedure - v8.1, last reviewed November 2025

Setelah mulai: tidak ada refund kecuali keadaan luar biasa. Visa pertama ditolak: refund penuh tuition dipotong admin NZD 500 (dengan surat INZ). Komisi agen tidak dikembalikan.
items.document: Halaman/dokumen refund resmi sekolah
items.summary_en: Withdrawal before start: full refund minus the admin fee stated in the Offer of Place. Transfer to another school before start (about 2 weeks' notice): 70% of tuition. After start: no refund except in exceptional circumstances. First visa refused: full tuition refund minus an NZD 500 admin fee (with an INZ letter). Agent commission is not refunded.
